fullPassage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.

questions.passage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to <u>create the illusion</u>. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 create the illusion이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: create the illusion=착시를 만들어 내다 → 실제로 변하는 것이 아니라 다른 생물처럼 '보이게' 눈속임을 만든다는 뜻.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 다른 생물처럼 보이도록 눈속임을 만든다: 문어는 팔을 접고 눈을 위로 향해 넙치처럼 '보이게' 함. 실제 변신이 아니라 착시(눈속임) ←정답

❌ ① 몸의 형태를 영구히 바꾼다: 착시는 일시적 눈속임이지 실제·영구 변형이 아님

❌ ③ 소리로 포식자를 위협: 본문에 없는 내용

❌ ④ 먹물로 시야를 가림: 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: illusion = 착시(실제가 아니라 그렇게 보이게 하는 눈속임)

ch: 실제로 몸의 형태를 영구히 다른 동물로 바꾼다
다른 생물처럼 보이도록 눈속임을 만들어 낸다
큰 소리를 내어 포식자를 위협해 쫓아낸다
먹물을 뿜어 물을 흐려 시야를 완전히 가린다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]을 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.
(문어는) 여덟 개의 팔을 모두 접은 채로 (있었다).
[조건] (1) all, arms, eight, folded, its, of, with를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 7단어로 쓸 것
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 여덟 개의 팔을 모두 접은 채로 = with all eight of its arms folded.
det.analysis: 원문: 'with all eight of its arms folded'. 'with + 명사 + 분사'는 '~가 …한 채로'라는 부대상황 표현이다. with(~한 채) + all eight of its arms(여덟 개의 팔 모두) + folded(접힌). 팔이 '접힌' 상태라 과거분사 folded를 쓴다
det.tip: with + 명사(all eight of its arms) + 과거분사(folded) = ~을 접은 채로

accept: with all eight of its arms folded

questions.passage: An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was __________ (use) these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥과 어법에 맞는 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: use(사용하다) → using: 'was ___'에서 be동사 was 뒤에 이어져 과거진행형(was using)을 이루므로 현재분사 using으로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: 'this one was __________ (use) these assets'에서 앞에 be동사 was가 있다. 'be + -ing'는 진행형이므로 동사 use를 현재분사 using으로 바꾸면 '이 강점들을 사용하고 있었다(was using)'가 된다
det.tip: was + 현재분사(using) = 과거진행형(~하고 있었다)

다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]을 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.
그들이 다시 보고 나서야 비로소 (문어를) 보았다.
[조건] (1) again, it, looked, only, saw, that, they, they, was, when을 모두 사용할 것 (they는 두 번)

(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 그들이 다시 보고 나서야 비로소 보았다 = It was only when they looked again that they saw.
det.analysis: 원문: 'It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus'. 'It was ~ that ...' 강조구문으로, 강조하는 말(only when they looked again=다시 보았을 때에야 비로소)을 It was와 that 사이에 넣는다. It was + only when they looked again(강조 부분) + that they saw(나머지) 순서
det.tip: It was + 강조할 말 + that ~ : '~한 것은 바로 …이다'(강조구문)

[ The / best / defence / have / most / octopus / of / species ]

(8단어) (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 대부분의 문어 종이 지닌 최선의 방어 = The best defence most species of octopus have.
det.analysis: 원문: 'The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden ...'. The best defence(최선의 방어)가 중심 명사이고, 그 뒤에 목적격 관계대명사가 생략된 채 'most species of octopus have'(대부분의 문어 종이 가진)가 꾸며 준다. species of octopus(문어의 종) 순서에 주의
det.tip: 명사(The best defence) + [관계사 생략] + 주어+동사(most species of octopus have)
